usage: In Cantonese, 厲害 (lai6 hoi6) is used to describe someone or something that is very impressive or powerful.
It can be used to praise abilities, skills, or performance, especially in sports or talents.
You can use 厲害 to show amazement or admiration for how well someone does something.
It can also imply something or someone is intense, fierce, or formidable in some way.
In casual speech, it’s common to use 厲害 on its own to react to impressive things or actions.

examples.jyutping: nei5 paau2 gam2 faai3, zan1 hai6 hou2 lai6 hoi6!
examples.meaning: You run so fast, really impressive!

examples.sentence: 佢打籃球好厲害，攞過好多獎。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 daa2 laam4 kau4 hou2 lai6 hoi6, lo2 gwo3 hou2 do1 zoeng2.
examples.meaning: He plays basketball very well and has won many awards.

examples.sentence: 今次比賽你嘅表現真係非常厲害！
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 nei5 ge3 biu2 jin2 zan1 hai6 fei1 soeng4 lai6 hoi6!
examples.meaning: Your performance in this tournament is truly impressive!

examples.sentence: 呢個招數好厲害，可以輕易打倒對手。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 ziu1 sou3 hou2 lai6 hoi6, ho2 ji5 heng1 ji6 daa2 dou2 deoi3 sau2.
examples.meaning: This move is very powerful and can easily defeat the opponent.
